name: LingBot-Map Streaming 3D Reconstruction
description: LingBot-Map Geometric Context Transformer: streaming RGB-D 3D reconstruction (per-frame depth, camera pose, and fused colored point cloud) from an ordered image sequence via native GGML inference, with optional native sky segmentation.
